title: Find the Locket
description: The locket is in the chest at the bridge crossing, latch still shut. Open it and the portrait inside isn't the man she described - younger, dark-haired, a face that's never been seen in Millbrook. Whoever this locket belonged to, take it back to her and let her tell you what it means.

objectives.description: Take the locket - the portrait inside raises questions of its own

notes: Turn (per REWRITE_SPEC): the portrait in the locket is not her husband. Left unresolved in the text - not explained, not flagged, not gated. No bible basis - local colour.
